data.name: SWOM
data.detailed_description:
SWOM — a new narrative survival game with magic elements, created by a solo developer.

You find yourself in a strange, mystical world where you must survive harsh conditions.

Explore the Open World: Wander through dark forests, investigate ancient ruins, descend into mysterious caves, and uncover the secrets of diverse biomes.

You are alone in a completely new world. Every artifact you find is not just an item, but a fragment of your personal history: past, present, and future. Who left these symbols for you? Why?

Surprisingly, you don't remember how you ended up in this mystery-shrouded world, and you don't know who you are. But your body remembers:

  • How to start a fire to save yourself from paralyzing cold and soul-crushing hunger.

  • How to avoid threats from dangerous approaching creatures.

  • How to steady the trembling in your hands before drawing your first magical symbol.

Here, magic is not just a spell list. It flows within the earth; it must not be memorized, but felt intuitively. You do not repeat ancient formulas; you transform them, creating your own charms.

Your Primary Objectives:

  • Gathering: Search for food, water, plants radiating magical energy, valuable minerals, and other survival supplies.

  • Building & Crafting: Construct reliable shelters from wood and stone, craft tools, weapons, and armor to help you withstand dangers.

  • Survival Stats: Monitor your health, stamina, hunger, and thirst. Maintain optimal body temperature, especially at night when the cold becomes a serious trial.

SWOM World Features:

  • Dangerous Creatures: Various beings inhabit this land, some of which pose a threat to you.

  • Dynamic Weather: Unpredictable atmospheric phenomena create additional challenges.

  • Day and Night Cycle: Darkness in this environment brings a heightened sense of threat to life — it is best to stay in shelter during this time.

  • The Sinister Green Moon: Periodically appearing in the sky, it marks the arrival of "The Hardest Hour." When the ringing silence drives your fear of encounter to the limit, and the only sound remaining in this space is the ringing in your ears.

As you play, you will gain new skills, magic keys, and improve your gear — all of which will help you survive and get closer to the main mystery of this game.

Your shelter is not just a roof over your head. It is a support that gives you energy to move forward. Use everything you find. Protect your space with spells that you create yourself, combining basic magical forces.

SWOM has a storyline, but completing it is optional — you are free to choose your own path:

  • Some will build a house just to live and pass the time.

  • Some will go deep into the forest to find that very answer.

  • Some will wait until finally, some sound breaks through the silence.

SWOM is not just survival. It is a game about your destiny, hidden in the twilight of a mysterious world.

P.S. The game is developed by one person. The world is inspired by tundras. Everything in the game is the developer's fiction, not a reflection of his or your life in another Universe.

data.short_description: SWOM — a game where you survive after memory loss, using magic based on basic laws you discover during gameplay. Build shelters, explore the unexplored world, collect items and resources to survive and understand why you are here.
data.supported_languages: English, Russian, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Thai, Turkish, Japanese
